mechanism: Past directional displacement adds information beyond realized variance about subsequent centre excursion.
expected_direction: Higher past drift predicts greater future excursion conditional on RV.
decision_change: Add one standardized directional displacement statistic to the frozen RV excursion model.
primary_comparison: RV-only versus RV-plus-drift on identical eligible sessions.
risk_constraints: Intraday only; no position beyond 15:00 IST
One historical lot; no unregistered leverage
Missing exits and rejected opportunities remain in the ledger
falsification_rule: The upper uncertainty bound rules out a 1% relative MAE reduction, or the effect is unstable against a simple scale predictor.
alternative_explanations: Anomalous sessions rather than persistent information
Spot predictability does not imply butterfly profitability

mechanism: Horizon-matched implied versus physical variance may identify states where collected premium exceeds expected path risk.
expected_direction: Higher same-horizon premium improves cost-adjusted whole-policy outcomes.
decision_change: Condition admission on a single frozen same-horizon variance-premium threshold.
primary_comparison: Unfiltered B0 versus premium-filtered B0 with identical eligible opportunities.
risk_constraints: Intraday only; no position beyond 15:00 IST
One historical lot; no unregistered leverage
Missing exits and rejected opportunities remain in the ledger
falsification_rule: Any benefit disappears after costs and exposure matching or the upper confidence bound is below the practical threshold.
alternative_explanations: Lower exposure rather than better selection

mechanism: Recent jumps and continuous variation may imply different short-gamma path risks despite equal total realized variance.
expected_direction: Greater jump pressure reduces subsequent cost-adjusted butterfly profitability.
decision_change: Replace total-RV admission with a frozen continuous-variation and jump-pressure decomposition.
primary_comparison: Total-RV filter versus decomposed filter on identical opportunities.

One historical lot; no unregistered leverage
Missing exits and rejected opportunities remain in the ledger
falsification_rule: No out-of-period incremental benefit remains after controlling total RV or uncertainty rules out practical improvement.

mechanism: Directional movement toward the held body may reduce position risk while equal movement away increases it.
expected_direction: A signed body-relative rule improves exit decisions versus absolute drift.

primary_comparison: Absolute-drift exit versus body-relative exit at identical states.

One historical lot; no unregistered leverage
Missing exits and rejected opportunities remain in the ledger
